name: Arindam Mukherjee
text: The emergency surgical team at Bastet saved Leo when he had an acute abdominal blockage. The compassion and surgical precision here are unmatched anywhere in Kolkata.

name: Priyanka Roy
text: Dr. Rohit completely healed Bella's chronic skin allergy with the right nutrition and targeted therapy. Truly royal treatment for our beloved pet!

text: From digital X-rays to gentle dental scaling, Bastet is equipped with the cleanest and most high-tech facilities in the city. Highly recommended!
